summary: Net income fell 27.4% to SAR 653M from SAR 900M; operating income dropped 36.4% to SAR 1.4B, driven by project milestone timing shifts.
Stock declined 4.12% to $193, down 30.6% from 52-week high, as investors reacted to earnings pressure and 6-12 month project delays.
ACWA secured exclusive Saudi mandate for green fuels exports including hydrogen, ammonia, and methanol; portfolio grew to 98 GW capacity.
Board recommended SAR 46/share dividend for 2025; new framework targets 30% payout ratio from 2027 with at least 50% paid in cash.
Management expects two financial closes in 2-3 months; maintains 6.6x net debt ratio with SAR 2.0-2.5B annual growth investment planned.
